title: This AI Agent Launches Hundreds of Meta Ads in Minutes
description:
We just built one of the most exciting internal tools our agency has ever used.
Instead of spending 30+ minutes manually trafficking ads, our AI agent reads creative assets directly from Figma, downloads everything automatically, generates on-brand copy, applies placement customization, and pushes ads into our Meta staging environment.
The result? Nearly two dozen ads launched in just a few minutes.
This is still a work in progress, but it's a glimpse into how AI agents will transform media buying, creative operations, and agency workflows.
In this video:
 ✅ Read creatives directly from Figma
 ✅ Generate ad copy automatically
 ✅ Customize placements at scale
 ✅ Push ads to Meta staging
 ✅ Launch dozens of ads in minutes
If you're interested in AI, media buying, performance marketing, and agency automation, subscribe for more content.
Comment "workflow" below if you'd like to see more behind-the-scenes breakdowns of our media buying systems.
